visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Introduction Phase: A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a light blue top and a black/white tracksuit jacket, stands in a sunny park. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands, while a split-screen comparison layout is established. The background shows vibrant green trees and park benches under natural daylight. (2) Static Comparison Phase: The scene cuts to the woman sitting on a wooden park bench. Multiple shots alternate between wide long shots (0.5x) and closer medium shots (1x, 4x, 8x), highlighting the zoom capabilities. She adjusts her hair and holds sunglasses, maintaining a pleasant facial expression. (3) Detail Comparison Phase: Close-up shots of a road sign ('BaDe Rd.') and a pink textured ice cream model are shown to compare digital zoom and macro details. The lighting is bright and direct, casting clear shadows on the textures of the objects. (4) Dynamic Activity Phase: The woman is seen using a red and yellow waist twister exercise machine in a playground area. The camera captures her in a medium shot as she moves rhythmically. The scene then transitions to a running shot where the woman moves toward the camera to test stabilization. (5) Conclusion Phase: The woman stands close to the camera again, smiling and pointing, while the stabilization comparison continues. The visual rhythm is fast-paced with frequent cuts between the two device perspectives.
